summary: Approved after an independent recheck of the corrected 38-question payload. All keyed answers remain defensible; all 24 recommended difficulty changes are applied; the two targeted Lippincott page corrections are present; unsupported generic course claims have been removed; and every retained course-scope question now has a directly inspected filename-and-slide locator for its base mechanism. No open content, source, schema, or difficulty finding remains.
checks: Revalidated all 38 question rows against schemas/mcq-question.schema.json with AJV 2020: zero failures.
Confirmed the final question-ID set exactly matches the 23 cardiovascular physiology, 6 respiratory physiology, and 9 biochemistry questions originally reviewed.
Confirmed every one of the 24 prior recommendedDifficulty values is now the final difficulty and that core/challenge tags agree with the final rating.
Confirmed all book source.page values explicitly identify Local PDF pages and source.chapter combines the book chapter with a descriptive topic section; printed pagination is not guessed.
Confirmed depth-bio-biochem-006 cites Local PDF 231, 248–250 and depth-bio-biochem-009 cites Local PDF 332–333.
Confirmed all nine biochemistry questions and all six cardiac-pump questions are book-extension and carry no generic lecture metadata.
Confirmed exactly nine physiology questions retain course-scope, each with a specific lecture filename and slide locator.

Directly compared the nine retained mappings with cvs-slides.json: slides 2:6–8 support pressure-flow and Poiseuille relations; slides 1:16–18 support parallel circuits; slides 3:10, 13–14, and 17 support pulse pressure, Reynolds reasoning, and the pressure-wave distinction; slide 4:11 supports the edema mechanism; and blood 2 slides 18 and 26–27 support factors XIII and vitamin K/liver linkage.
Confirmed the known reversed Reynolds inequality on Cairculatory System 3 slide 14 is explicitly flagged and the question follows Guyton's correct direction.

Confirmed concepts.json, modules.json, and coverage.json are flat arrays with examId on each row where required; concept objectives retain the reviewed question mappings and coverage rows use the accepted mapped status.
